rank) so the sum is exact and batch invariant, excluding prefix items.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rp FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rp) AS rp FROM lp WHERE rp <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, CAST(sum(pr.c * (6 - li.rp)) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item GROUP BY li.session, pr.dst), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}, {"name": "hist_next_int", "idea": "Items that followed the session's last 3 prefix items within 3 events in history sessions of the last 7 days, cart or order followers weighted triple, with integer recency weights (4 - rank) for an exact batch-invariant score, excluding prefix items.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rp FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rp) AS rp FROM lp WHERE rp <= 3 GROUP BY session, item), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) + 2 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.event <> 'view' THEN y.session END) AS c FROM a JOIN hist y ON y.session = a.session AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 3 AND y.item <> a.item WHERE y.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, CAST(sum(pr.c * (4 - li.rp)) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item GROUP BY li.session, pr.dst), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}, {"name": "b2b_src", "idea": "Items co-carted or co-ordered in history (tb_buy2buy) with the session's last 20 distinct prefix items, prefix cart/order items weighted triple, integer-exact sums, excluding prefix items.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(CASE WHEN s.event <> 'view' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), li AS (SELECT session, item, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, w FROM li WHERE rp <= 20), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, b.item2 AS item, CAST(sum(b.tv_ns * lt.w) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM lt JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, b.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}, {"name": "view2cart", "idea": "Directed table over the last 14 days of history: items carted or ordered within 30 events after the item in the same session, counted once per session, with the number of sessions where it was ordered.", "kind": "table", "level": "item_pair", "sql": "WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400), b AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order')), d AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS item2, max(CASE WHEN b.event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM b JOIN h a ON a.session = b.session AND a.item <> b.item AND a.seq BETWEEN b.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.session, a.item, b.item), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS tv_ns, sum(bb) AS tv_nb FROM d GROUP BY item, item2 HAVING count(*) >= 2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_ns, tv_nb, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_ns DESC, tv_nb DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(tv_ns AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(tv_nb AS DOUBLE) AS tv_nb FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"}]
